snippet.title: Select Eleven Trailer | Cricket management game (Windows, MacOS)
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4758090/Select_Eleven/

Select Eleven is a single-player, text-based cricket management game. Scout players, pick your eleven and follow matches through scores, commentary and analysis. Take charge of a club and build its squad across seasons.

Choose your club

Start with one of 180 clubs across India, Australia, England, New Zealand, South Africa, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Nepal. Take on a promotion challenge or the expectations of a top-division side.

Play T20 leagues and national 50-over cups. Domestic results can earn a place in the following season’s T20 World Club Championship or Cross-Nation ODI Cup.


Find your next signing

Send scouts after the players your squad needs. Compare reports and attributes, negotiate transfers and contracts, then weigh up form and fitness before choosing your eleven.

Develop your next star

Set training priorities and invest in your youth academy. Follow your players’ development, manage their fitness and morale, and decide when a prospect is ready for senior cricket.


Make the matchday calls

Set your batting tempo, promote a batter or choose the next over’s bowler. Follow the match through ball-by-ball scores and commentary. Pause to think, change playback speed or simulate to the result.

Build a club that lasts

Balance wages and transfer spending, hire staff and secure sponsors. Improve your stadium, training facilities and academy while keeping the board and supporters onside.
